{{Quote|Centuries back, the Jedi had an outpost on Taris. They left shortly before the world burned&mdash;I'm here to recover anything left behind. But between the fauna and the looters, I haven't had much luck. We were hoping for holocrons, diaries&mdash;Jedi history! In truth, we knew it was a long shot.|Devon Race|<ref name="Indelicate Operations" />}}
'''Devon Race''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Near the end of his training, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Silvarte]] granted Race permission to travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and explore the ruins of the old [[Jedi Tower|Jedi Enclave]] in hopes of recovering Jedi artifacts. However, Race and his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T4-U5]] were driven off by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[rakghoul]]s in the area, so Race sought help from other Republic-allied individuals in the area.<ref name="Indelicate Operations" />
